name: uuid
description: RFC 4122 / RFC 9562 UUIDs for Bantu — uuid4 (random, CSPRNG-backed), uuid7 (time-ordered/sortable), and uuid3/uuid5 (deterministic name-based, MD5/SHA-1), with namespaces and parse/format/is_valid/version_of. Pure Bantu on native primitives; bit-exact to the RFC name-based vectors.
